Name: Spouse Outdoor Area
Author: Shaklin
Description:
With this mod all player can set and move their own Spouse Outdoor Area in multiplayer.
Hold a [b]bouquet of flowers[/b] in your hand and press [b]Space[/b].

You have to be married to see your own Spouse Outdoor Area Building.
Your spouse will use it every Saturday, when it's not winter and it's not raining.

All Players need this mod, if you play together.


Once you start the game, a config.json file is created:
[b]{
  "Set_Area_Key": "Space",
  "Area_Position_X": 0,
  "Area_Position_Y": 0,
  "Area_Variant": "Auto"
}[/b]

[b]Set_Area_Key [/b]= The Key to set it
[b]Area_Position_X [/b]and [b]Area_Position_Y [/b]= The Spouse Outdoor Area position
[b]Area_Variant [/b]= [b]"Auto"[/b]: auto means it will be adapted to your spouse.
or you write a name, then the building will be taken from this one.

Possible names:
[i]Abigail
Alex
Elliott
Emily
Haley
Harvey
Leah
Maru
Penny
Sam
Sebastian
Shane[/i]

for example:
[b]"Area_Variant": "Shane"

[/b]
If you don't want ﻿your own Spouse Outdoor Area anymore, log out and delete the config.json.
The other player just need to change the current location, then it will reload eveything.

[size=2]I can not really test it in Multiplayer, if you have any problems just delete the mod and load your game.
And everything should be normal.[/size]
